race.description: Sixt Car & Truck Rental Tamworth Pace
race.comment: RAINBOW TITAN (2) didn't do a bad job when sixth from the back row over 1609m at this track last time out. Goes well at this longer distance and is better suited up to this longer distance. ADRENALINE RUSH (1) could only manage tenth when resuming but she had a tough draw. Fitter for that and is much better served by the ace draw so expect big improvement. RIPPIN GOOD FEELIN (5) has recorded two wins and two minor placings from the past five starts. Performed well once again when third at his latest appearance over 1609m at this track, beaten 2.25 metres. Go well again. OUR ART CHRISTIAN NZ (6) has not raced for four months but looks forward enough after a minor placing in a recent trial. Include.
